name: Alplig
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Gasthof Alplig is located in the village of **Ischgl**, Tyrol. The rooms feature en-suite bathrooms, cable TV, and free Wi-Fi. The house includes a restaurant serving traditional Tyrolean cuisine. A wellness area is available for guests' use. A ski storage room with ski-drying facilities and parking spaces are also provided. The **Silvretta Arena** ski resort is just a short walk away. This accommodation serves as an all-year-round base for exploring the region’s activities.
